project_type: Offline-first WFRP 4e character-sheet PWA — TypeScript + React 19 + Vite, CSS Modules, lucide-react icons, createPortal overlays. No backend/network/LLM/telemetry.
build_system: Vite 8 + tsc --build (project references). NOTE: typescript is aliased to @typescript/typescript6 for the eslint parser, while @typescript/native provides the real tsc 7.0.2 binary used by build/typecheck (see the //typescript-eslint-compat note in package.json). Do not touch these aliases.
test_command: vitest --run   (alias: npm test). Scope a path, e.g. `vitest --run src/logic/guided-disease`.
verification_instructions: All four gates must be clean after implementation (AC-21): (1) `npx tsc --build --force --noEmit`; (2) `npm run build`; (3) `vitest --run`; (4) `npx eslint .` with 0 errors and no new warnings. Run per-feature scoped tests during development, then the full suite at convergence. Fix every error on sight (fix-errors steering), keep fixes rulebook-compliant, do not alter existing pure logic.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No generated/checked-in snapshot files for this task.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell shell. Offline-first: introduce NO backend/network/LLM/telemetry call (NFR-1). One aria-modal at a time (NFR-3): the guide overlay must yield (not render) while its seeded RollDialog is open, mirroring SpellCastingPanel. All new mechanic-bearing code must carry a `// Core p.XXX: …` citation verified against docs/WarhammerFantasyRoleplay4e.md (rules-compliance steering).
contribution_requirements: Strictly additive (NFR-2): existing tests stay green UNCHANGED; the only new default-render DOM in existing panels is one opt-in trigger per CorruptionCard and one per rendered active-disease row in DiseasePanel. Do NOT fork or duplicate src/logic/diseases.ts, src/logic/corruption.ts, src/data/mutation-tables.ts, or the assistant rules in src/logic/assistant/rules/. Every calculated total displayed in the UI must have a breakdown Tooltip (calculated-totals steering). Reducers are pure/React-free/JSON-serializable with fast-check property tests (NFR-6).
key_patterns: Guided flow = pure reducer (src/logic/guided-cast/{types,reducer,steps}.ts) + portal overlay (GuidedCastPanel.tsx) + opt-in trigger (GuidedCastTrigger.tsx), HOSTED by the existing panel that owns useReducer + the seeded RollDialog (SpellCastingPanel.tsx). Advisor uses a sync-or-async-union describe() contract (CastAdvisorSource) and ships only a deterministic sync default; panel narrows `info instanceof Promise ? null : info`. Seeded rolls: `const { total } = resolveSeededTarget(character, def)` (def is a ReminderTest from src/logic/reminders.ts) → setRollDialogState({ name, baseTarget: total, difficulty }) → render shared RollDialog with defaultDifficulty, onRoll records to shared history then closes. resolveSeededTarget(...).lines IS the one source of truth for base-target tooltips. Tooltips use TooltipTriggerCell + Tooltip with a single openTooltipId + anchor state per panel. Mutation d100s and Gangrene Hit-Location d100 are NEVER seeded into RollDialog — they stay on the existing CorruptionCard roller / DiseasePanel location control (close-and-return hand-off).
